in_sanskrit.name: सक्ष्मा
in_sanskrit.meaning: to see, to witness, to perceive
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who sees or perceives, derived from the verb root 'saks' meaning 'to know, to be acquainted with'

in_hindi.name: सक्ष्मा
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who sees or witnesses, in Hindi, derived from the verb root 'saksh' meaning 'to be present, to witness'

in_tamil.name: சக்ஷமா
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who perceives or understands, in Tamil, derived from the verb root 'saksh' meaning 'to know'

in_telugu.name: శక్ష్మా
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who sees or knows, in Telugu, derived from the verb root 'saksh' meaning 'to be present, to witness'

in_marathi.name: Sakshma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sakshma हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who perceives or observes reality accurately, without any distortion or illusion. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Saksh' which means 'witness' or 'observer'.

in_bengali.name: Sakshma
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sakshma একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who perceives or observes reality accurately, without any distortion or illusion. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Saksh' which means 'witness' or 'observer'.
